class.name: NetwDatabaseConnection
class.brief_description: One open slot's storage, and the only object that performs storage I/O.
class.description: A backend describes where saves live. A connection is one open slot of that storage, and it is what a game subclasses to reach storage the shipped backends do not cover. Opening the same backend twice makes two connections, so nothing a connection holds is shared with the next one. The connection performs four acts. [method _read] reads one address, [method _scan] reads a page of them, [method _write_batch] applies complete replacements and erasures, and [method _close] releases the slot. Every other verb [NetwDatabase] publishes is built from those, including [method NetwDatabase.patch], which is an ordered read, merge and replace. Every method answers a [NetwPromise]. A method this connection does not implement rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE], and never a successful empty answer. [b]Address[/b] Every read, scan and operation names what it is about with the same three fields. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴kind int 0 for a record, 1 for a table snapshot ┠╴schema_name String the schema the record belongs to ┖╴key String the record's durable id [/codeblock] An envelope is a stored record as [NetwDatabase] sealed it. Store it as given and answer it back unchanged.

method.name: _close
method.description: Releases this slot. It is called once the database has settled every operation it admitted, so nothing is outstanding when it runs. Closing an already closed connection succeeds. [method NetwDatabase.close] settles without waiting for this promise, and nothing reads what it resolves.

method.name: _read
method.description: Reads the record at [param address] and resolves a reply. Report a record that is not stored as [code]found[/code] false at [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. An error means storage could not be asked, and it is never read as absence. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or why storage could not be asked ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a record is stored at address ┖╴envelope Dictionary the envelope last written to address, only when found [/codeblock] [method NetwDatabase.read] answers [code]error[/code] and [code]detail[/code] as its own. A reject reaches it as the reject's code and detail.

method.name: _scan
method.description: Reads one page of records matching [param request] and resolves a reply. Bound the remote work each call performs, and answer a cursor whenever records remain. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴schema_name String the schema every record in the page belongs to ┠╴kind int the address kind, 0 for a record ┠╴filter Dictionary the filter the game passed to NetwDatabase.scan ┠╴cursor String the previous page's cursor, empty on the first page ┖╴limit int the most records one page may carry [/codeblock] The reply carries the page and where the next one starts. A page shorter than [code]limit[/code] with a nonempty [code]cursor[/code] is not the end of the scan. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or why the page could not be read ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴records Array[Dictionary] │ ┖╴record │ ┠╴key String the record's durable id │ ┖╴envelope Dictionary the envelope last written to it ┖╴cursor String where the next page starts, empty when the scan is done [/codeblock] [method NetwDatabase.scan] answers [code]error[/code] and [code]detail[/code] as its own. A reject, or one record whose envelope does not open against the schema, fails the whole page.

method.name: _write_batch
method.description: Applies [param operations] in order and resolves one outcome per operation, in that same order. Each is a complete replacement or erasure, because [NetwDatabase] has already merged anything a patch needed. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴operation ┠╴kind String "replace" or "erase" ┠╴address Dictionary the address drawn in this class's description ┖╴envelope Dictionary the record to store, replace only [/codeblock] Report [constant @GlobalScope.OK] only for an operation the backing store acknowledged, never for one that is only queued. When a timeout or a lost link leaves an outcome unknown, mark it uncertain. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or a failure of the whole batch ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴errors PackedInt32Array one Error per operation ┖╴uncertain PackedByteArray 1 where the outcome is unknown, 0 otherwise [/codeblock] An [code]errors[/code] of the wrong length fails every operation with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA], and a reject fails every operation with the reject's code. An entity row whose outcome is uncertain stays [member NetwPersistenceHandle.dirty].

method.name: close_default
method.description: The stock [method _close], which succeeds without doing anything. A subclass overriding [method _close] calls this to reach it.

method.name: read_default
method.description: The stock [method _read], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _read] calls this to reach it.

method.name: scan_default
method.description: The stock [method _scan], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _scan] calls this to reach it.

method.name: write_batch_default
method.description: The stock [method _write_batch], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _write_batch] calls this to reach it.
